overall_quality.evidence: Eventual consistency is a property of distributed data storage systems where data is replicated across multiple nodes. It ensures that all nodes will eventually agree on the latest state of the data, but there can be temporary inconsistencies. This means that after a write operation, the data might not be immediately available on all nodes, and it may take some time for all nodes to synchronize. This approach is often used in NoSQL databases to balance between performance and data integrity.
